messages:
Ari: Heads up, I just put a trade offer in the fantasy league: my Soto for Sam's Albies + bench swap. Thoughts?
Sam: ugh Albies is streaky but ok. who needs Soto? :thinking_face:
Jordan: Show the full offer please — holding veto power rn.
Ari: ```
Trade: Ari gives: Juan Soto
       Sam gives: Ozzie Albies + Miguel S. (bench)
Reason: Need 2B depth, Soto is an OF surplus for me
```
Leah: Noted. My knee-jerk: reject if it looks lopsided but also check pts per week.
Sam: I can sweeten with a waiver pickup (in two days) if that helps. Also I promise not to cry if vetoed. :pleading_face:
Jordan: Vote: accept. Soto helps my scoring in OBP weeks.
Ari: @Sam can we add a small 2nd-round pick to make it cleaner?
Sam: Sure, add 2nd pick (this season).
Leah: Vote: accept now that there's a pick.
notif-bot: Trade updated by Sam: Albies + Miguel S. + 2nd-round pick for Soto. Waiting on league votes.
Jordan: Also unrelated but important 10: who brought corgi pics to slack yesterday? Need to repost them in #random for morale. :dog2: :heart_eyes:
Ari: That was me. I'll drop a folder of corgi content in the thread after trade settles. Low-effort, high-reward.
Sam: Vote submitted: accept.
Leah: Vote submitted: accept.
Jordan: Vote submitted: accept.
notif-bot: Trade passed (4-0). Transaction completed.
Ari: Sweet. Posting corgi album now: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder (sfw) :dog:
Leah: Bless you. Also reminder: waiver claims close at midnight.
Sam: Good win. Who wants to split celebratory bagels tomorrow? I owe one per loss ratio.
Ari: I'll take half. Jordan take the other half?
Jordan: Deal. Correlation between trades and carbs is now scientifically proven. :bagel:
notif-bot: Reminder scheduled: waiver claims close in 6 hours.
